decisions_made.decision: Cinema Subpixel Auto-Scroll Engine for Carousel
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates jumpy stepped transitions and integer truncation stutter on 120Hz ProMotion screens, providing an ultra-smooth, continuous reading drift that pauses naturally upon touch.

decisions_made.decision: Synchronous Audio Trigger on User Gesture
decisions_made.reason: iOS Safari WebKit requires audio.play() to be invoked directly inside the click event call stack rather than inside asynchronous setTimeout callbacks.
Compact 40-44px translucent buttons with subtle opacity (75%) keep media controls easily accessible for thumb reach without obscuring card content.
